title: Anza project manifest
description: Optional anza.json — remaps structure slots and declares extra page trees / service workers. Omit the file to use scaffold defaults (src/app.js, src/pages/, src/sw.js, …). See docs/intro/structure.md and plans/STRUCTURE.md.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation (optional).

src.description: App source root relative to the project root.

entry.description: Module entry filename relative to src.

shell.description: HTML shell filename relative to src.

rootDock.description: Name of the root dock registration (dock(...)).

pages.description: Page tree directories relative to src. Default is ["pages"]. Extra trees (e.g. "docs") are blessed when imported from entry/barrels; list them here for tooling hints. Each meaningful folder should expose an index barrel.

docks.description: Docks slot directory relative to src. Optional at runtime — dock() may live in app.js. Each meaningful folder should expose an index barrel.

views.description: Optional global views slot directory relative to src (recommended model). Remap this path; do not treat views as a per-dock custom-element registry. Co-location under docks/user folders is organization only — tags stay global. Each meaningful folder should expose an index barrel.

parts.description: Parts slot directory relative to src. Each meaningful folder should expose an index barrel.

tokens.description: Design tokens directory relative to src.

styles.description: Global styles directory relative to src.

sw.description: Service Worker entry or entries relative to src. String = single entry (scaffold back-compat). Array = paths and/or { path, scope } for multi-scope registrations. Default when omitted: src/sw.js if present. Optional src/sw/ holds shared modules only — not auto-registered workers.

oneOf.description: SW script path relative to src; scope defaults to the script URL directory at register time.

path.description: SW script path relative to src.

scope.description: Registration scope for navigator.serviceWorker.register(url, { scope }). Advisory for tooling; registration stays in app code.
